第9章条条大路通罗马，条条罗马似地狱！

赵佛儿在门边目送着秦云身影，直到再也看不见秦云，这才退回屋里，将门锁好。

秦云走得很快，没多少会儿就来到了山上。

山里的雪要比村里更深，而且由于没什么人走动的缘故，一脚踩下去甚至能够到小腿。

呼呼的寒风从秦岭深处贯穿而下。

冬天的风，特别是秦岭山脉中的风，吹在人的脸上，就好像有人在拿刀片割肉一样的感觉。

疼得秦云下意识把皮帽往下拉了拉！

让自己的脸更多的处在皮帽的遮盖范围内。

就连看东西都微眯着眼，看着周围的方向。

深山老林里的路并不好走，同时边走，秦云也边梳理着自己脑子中有关于大宋的历史。

事到如今，他也弄明白了，自己穿越过来的并非一个什么架空的世界，而是历史上真实存在的宋朝。

从穿越到现在不过两天的时间。

但这两天的时间里，他杀的人可不算少，经历的事情也不算少。

先是杀了一个想要吃他的签军，然后又莫名其妙被发配了一个老婆，三天之后还要去服苦役，再然后就灭人满门……

宁为太平犬，不为乱世人。

这句话的含金量直到今天他才想明白，在乱世之中，人命比纸薄。

甚至活生生的人都可以被当作粮食来进行衡量，哪怕上辈子他当雇佣兵，在那些战乱区域摸爬打滚十几年，自认为什么人间地狱没见过，可这两天经历的事情还是刷新了他的世界观。

上辈子他待的那些地方就算再乱，至少明面上还会有秩序的存在。

可如今这个世道呢？

谁敢说有所谓的秩序？人吃人，人卖人。

靖康二年。

四个大字记载的是一个年份，在后世的人看来，这只不过是一段文字。

可真的身处其中，秦云才明白这个年代有多么的恐怖。

金兵南下，两路大军会师汴京城下。

大宋的皇帝和太上皇，连同整个皇亲国戚都被掳去了北国，史称二圣北狩。

据传汴京城的大火光烧就烧了三天三夜，汴京城上空食腐的乌鸦盘旋了更是半月有余，大宋的皇帝就更是可笑了。

兵临城下之际，居然还指望用神兵天降这种招数来退敌。

最终敌人没退，自己反倒落得个青衣侑酒的下场，在北国的冰天雪地里给人当乐子。

也间接导致了沦陷区的汉人地位不如猪羊，甚至沦落为了最低等的食物。

Chapter 9: All roads lead to Rome, but all roads lead to Rome!

Zhao Fo'er watched Qin Yun's figure by the door, and then returned to the house and locked the door until Qin Yun could no longer be seen.

Qin Yun walked very fast and arrived at the mountain in a short time.

The snow in the mountains is deeper than in the village, and because there are few people walking around, it can even reach your calves when you step on it.

The whistling cold wind blows down from the depths of the Qinling Mountains.

The winter wind, especially the wind in the Qinling Mountains, blows on people's faces, as if someone is cutting flesh with a blade.

It hurt so much that Qin Yun subconsciously pulled down his leather hat!

Let your face be more covered by the leather hat.

Even when looking at things, he squinted his eyes slightly and looked in the direction around him.

The road in the deep mountains and old forests was not easy to walk. At the same time, Qin Yun was sorting out the history of the Song Dynasty in his mind.

Now, he has figured out that the world he traveled to is not an imaginary world, but the Song Dynasty that actually existed in history.

It has only been two days since time travel.

But in the past two days, he had killed quite a few people and experienced quite a few things.

First, he killed a signer who wanted to eat him, and then he was assigned a wife for no apparent reason. Three days later, he had to do hard labor, and then he killed everyone in his family...

I would rather be a peace dog than a person in troubled times.

It wasn't until today that he understood the value of this sentence. In troubled times, human life is thinner than paper.

Even living people can be measured as food. Even though he worked as a mercenary in his previous life and crawled around in war-torn areas for more than ten years, thinking that he had never seen any hell on earth, what he experienced in the past two days still refreshed his world view.

Even if the places he stayed in in his previous life were chaotic, at least there would still be order on the surface.

But what about today’s world?

Who dares to say that there is such a thing as order?People eat people, people sell people.

The second year of Jingkang.

The four big characters record a year. In the eyes of later generations, this is just a paragraph of text.

But when he was actually in it, Qin Yun understood how terrifying this era was.

The Jin soldiers moved south, and the two armies met at the foot of Bianjing City.

The emperor and the supreme emperor of the Song Dynasty, as well as the entire emperor's relatives and relatives, were taken captive to the Northern Kingdom. It was known in history as the Two Saints' Northern Hunting.

It is said that the fire in Bianjing City burned for three days and three nights. The scavenging crows hovered over Bianjing City for more than half a month. The emperor of the Song Dynasty was even more ridiculous.

When the army approached the city, they actually expected to use magic weapons to descend from the sky to repel the enemy.

In the end, the enemy did not retreat, but he ended up as a Qingyi Yujiu, making fun of others in the ice and snow of the North Country.

It also indirectly led to the status of the Han people in the occupied areas being inferior to pigs and sheep, and even being reduced to the lowest food.
